figurative_meaning_en: Devoid of knowledge of benefit and harm
similar_in_english: No sense of right and wrong
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে এমন রাগ না চণ্ডাল যে, বন্ধুর অসদ্ভাবনায়ও কিছু বোঝে না।
এই রাগ না চণ্ডাল লোকটি নিজের ক্ষতির কথা ভাবতেই পারে না।
example_sentences_in_english: He is such a rag na chandal that he doesn't even recognize his friend's ill intentions.
This rag na chandal person can't even think about his own losses.
history: Refers to the historical caste system in Bengal where 'Chandal' denoted a low or outcaste group, implying extreme indifference even to the lowest offenses.
note: The idiom draws from traditional social hierarchies in Bengali culture.
